gaps: Cohabiting couples who never married are not a separate path; the chain counts marriages only.
Divorce follows women's first-marriage survival (NSFG) for every marriage, including remarriages and men's.
Never-married shares by age are a cross-section of 2024, not each cohort's own history.

A household of relatives without children under 18 is seated as one parent and one grown child; siblings, grandparents raising grandchildren and other relatives living together are not separate shapes.
Housemates who are not related draw their ages one at a time from the place's living arrangements; how alike two housemates' ages are is not read.
Spouses' age difference is the national CPS distribution for every place and both opposite-sex and same-sex couples; unmarried partners use the married couples' distribution.
